payout_quote: Your checking account is eligible for up to 6 consecutive cash bonuses. Tracking begins the first calendar day of the month following account opening. Each month you meet offer requirements listed above, a $100 cash bonus will be paid to your account approximately 10 days after the beginning of the next month. For example, you open your account in November and tracking begins December 1. In December you have $1,000 in qualifying direct deposits; the first $100 cash bonus will be paid to your account in January. In January you have $900 in qualifying direct deposits; you will not be paid the second $100 cash bonus in February. The promo code is applied to the first Smart Money Checking, Smart Advantage Checking, or Relationship Checking account that is opened between September 9, 2026 and December 15, 2026.
